scripts.typecheck: node --check studio.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'),s=fs.readFileSync('studio.ts','utf8').trim(),m=h.match(/<script type=\"module\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/);if(!m||m[1].trim()!==s){console.error('studio.ts and index.html script differ');process.exit(1)}"
